6. Which voice delete route exists? Are cancel and resume the same operation?

8. How can my app import a customer’s own number using the API?

11. Does [TRANSFER] always use the agent’s shared destination? Can I make this tenant-specific?

14. Does an agent catalogue voice always beat a number’s voice_id?
15. Can two numbers on one agent use different knowledge or turn it off just for one number?
16. If someone texts STOP to customer A, can customer B in the same account still campaign to them?
17. Do Cal.com and Google Calendar both select a per-number booking timezone?
18. How do I verify and route call.bookings across tenants? Can I get a number-specific secret?

24. For an inbound call, do tenant instructions replace all the shared agent instructions?
25. If we write our customer’s facts only in the phone profile, do SMS and the web widget automatically reuse them?
